short: Dirichlet L-functions are zero-free right of one half

statements.markdown: Statement 2.2 (LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re). For every modulus N ≥ 1, every Dirichlet character χ modulo N and every s ∈ C with Re s > 12 , if χ ̸ = 1 or s ̸ = 1 then L(s, χ) ̸ = 0.

lean.name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re
lean.plain: Dirichlet L-functions are zero-free right of one half
lean.fidelity_note: Unfolding `DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf` gives the same complex Dirichlet characters and the same condition $\operatorname{Re}s>1/2$. Lean’s `NeZero N` on a natural modulus means $N\ge1$. The disjunction `χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1` excludes exactly the trivial-character case at $s=1$.
